requests.title: Medium-size American football stadium
requests.brief: Create an original stylized open-air American football stadium with roughly 25,000-seat proportions. Use the reference to study the playing field, stepped seating, aisles, press box and scoreboard; design an original exterior and circulation layout rather than copying university names, logos or surrounding buildings. The capacity is a scale assumption, not a counted-seat requirement. Follow the Molen polygonal building style and deliver a useful textured exterior-and-bowl asset visible from all sides and above.
features: A green American football field with distinct end zones, repeated white yard lines and a goalpost at each end
Substantial stepped seating along both sidelines with visible aisle gaps and a clear view of the field
A press box above one main stand, a large scoreboard and tall stadium floodlights
Grounded stand supports, a surrounding concourse and recognizable spectator entrances
Coherent medium-size stadium proportions with an open central bowl and finished exterior faces
